recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-22268 unless a future work-group decision reopens the semantics of these canonical status codes.
issue_request: FHIR-22268 was a Published FHIR-core/MnM change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked whether the Resource Status CodeSystem definitions for behind-target and not-ready were correct; the approved resolution was to move the existing not-ready definition to behind-target, add a definition for not-ready, and add a title to the CodeSystem.
initial_application: Commit ec83d5b5057f1402bdeb77453f5d214806de6b8c explicitly included FHIR-22268 and changed source/codesystem/codesystem-resource-status.xml so behind-target is defined as "Behind the planned timelines" and not-ready is defined as "Not ready to act". The separate title element was completed later by terminology metadata cleanup commit a4993e2ff438ead32021ed417a492f73e0795bbb.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active [codesystems] entry for resource-status pointing to source/codesystem/codesystem-resource-status.xml. Confluence minutes corroborate the MnM 4-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote, and broader Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later final decision or community evidence requiring different definitions for behind-target or not-ready.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The published combined-branch commit is an empty no-change audit because the current build-scope CodeSystem already satisfies the issue.
